senses.gloss: haunch, thigh, i.e. “the thick and fleshy member which commences at the bottom of the spine and extends to the lower leg (שׁוֹק)” (Ges. H. Dict. s. v.).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 7:1">Ḥull. VII, 1</cite> <he>נוהג בי׳ של ימין</he> applies to the right leg.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 7:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>שולח אדם י׳ וכ׳</he> one may send to a gentile a haunch with the nervus ischiadicus (v. <cite ref="C00626"><he>גִּיד</he></cite>) in it.

Sot. 11ᵇ; Ex. R. s. 1 י׳ מכאן וי׳ מכאן וכ׳ a leg on one side, and a leg on the other, and the potter’s mould between; a. fr.—Y. Pes. VII, beg. 34ᵃ כיָרֵיךְ עבה עבד וכ׳ R. J … wants the Passover lamb roasted like a thick (stuffed) thigh.—יוצאי י׳ descendants.
B. Bath. VIII, 2 כל יוצאי יְרֵיכוֹ של בן וכ׳ all direct descendants of the (deceased) son (male heir) have the precedence to the daughter (the decedent’s sister); a. fr.—Du. יְרֵכַיִם.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 3:4">Tosef. Ohol. III, 4</cite>, sq.—Pl. <he>יְרֵיכוֹת</he>. Sot. l. c.; Ex. R. l. c. (expl. <he>אָבְנַיִם</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 1:16">Ex. I, 16</cite>) <he>בשעה … יְרֵכיֹתֶיהָ … כאבנים</he> when a woman is about to give birth, her thighs grow cold like stones.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 69:2">Gen. R. s. 69</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00175"><he>חָדד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 13a:23">Meg. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>אין אשה … בי׳ של חבירתה</he> a woman is made jealous only by the side of another woman (rival).

senses.gloss: the perpendicular stroke of a letter, leg.
units: Y. Meg. I, 71ᶜ top יְרֵיכוֹ של ה״א the leg (stroke on the left side) of the He; ib. י׳ קטנה a small indication of it.
Ib. אם גורדו … י׳ קטנה if he erases the (blotted letter Gimmel) and there remains a slight leg (indication of the vertical stroke connecting the head of the Gimmel with its foot).—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 138b:8">Sabb. 138ᵇ</cite> <he>כירה … אחת מִיְּרֵכוֹתֶיהָ</he> a portable stove one of whose legs is off.
